```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

df <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nathanielcross04/MPP-Capstone/refs/heads/main/Data/Final%20data/state_distances%20(raw%20and%20deltas).csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

YEARS       <- 2000:2019
DELTA_YEARS <- 2001:2019

extract_series <- function(prefix, years) {
  cols    <- paste0(prefix, "_", years)
  present <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  yrs_out <- years[paste0(prefix, "_", years) %in% names(df)]
  mat     <- df[, present, drop = FALSE]
  list(years  = as.integer(yrs_out),
       states = df$state,
       values = lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) as.numeric(mat[i, ])))
}

extract_clusters <- function(years) {
  cols    <- paste0("cluster_", years)
  present <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  yrs_out <- years[paste0("cluster_", years) %in% names(df)]
  mat     <- df[, present, drop = FALSE]
  list(years  = as.integer(yrs_out),
       states = df$state,
       values = lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) as.integer(mat[i, ])))
}

payload <- list(
  global_raw          = extract_series("dist_1cs",             YEARS),
  global_raw_delta    = extract_series("dist_1cs_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  global_ranked       = extract_series("rank_1cs",             YEARS),
  global_ranked_delta = extract_series("rank_1cs_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  own_raw             = extract_series("dist_own",             YEARS),
  own_raw_delta       = extract_series("dist_own_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  own_ranked          = extract_series("rank_own",             YEARS),
  ext_raw             = extract_series("extremity",            YEARS),
  ext_raw_delta       = extract_series("extremity_delta",      DELTA_YEARS),
  ext_ranked          = extract_series("rank_extremity",       YEARS),
  ext_ranked_delta    = extract_series("rank_extremity_delta", DELTA_YEARS),
  clusters            = extract_clusters(YEARS),
  all_dist_1cs        = extract_series("dist_1cs",             YEARS),
  all_rank_1cs        = extract_series("rank_1cs",             YEARS),
  all_delta_1cs       = extract_series("dist_1cs_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  all_dist_own        = extract_series("dist_own",             YEARS),
  all_rank_own        = extract_series("rank_own",             YEARS),
  all_delta_own       = extract_series("dist_own_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  all_extremity       = extract_series("extremity",            YEARS),
  all_rank_ext        = extract_series("rank_extremity",       YEARS),
  all_delta_ext       = extract_series("extremity_delta",      DELTA_YEARS),
  ann_global          = ann_global,
  ann_own             = ann_own,
  ann_extremity       = ann_extremity
)

json_payload <- toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 6, na = "null")
```

```{=html}
    extremes_top1:"Closest 3 per cluster highlighted; the closest per cluster carry a white bubble."
  },
  extremity: {
    none:"No highlighting applied.",
    clusters:"Cell fill shows each state's cluster membership.",
    extremes:"The 3 most extreme (furthest) states each year are highlighted in orange. Ties are all colored.",
    top1:"The most extreme state(s) each year carry a bubble in orange.",
    clusters_top1:"Cluster fill applied; the most extreme state(s) carry a white bubble.",
    extremes_top1:"Top 3 most extreme highlighted; the most extreme state(s) carry a white bubble."
  }
};

// ── STATE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let curMeasure="global", curTransform="raw", curColor="none", dtInstance=null;

// ── COLOUR HELPERS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function hexToRgb(h){return[parseInt(h.slice(1,3),16)/255,parseInt(h.slice(3,5),16)/255,parseInt(h.slice(5,7),16)/255];}
function rgbToHex(r,g,b){return'#'+[r,g,b].map(v=>Math.round(Math.min(1,Math.max(0,v))*255).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}
function lighten(hex,amt){const[r,g,b]=hexToRgb(hex);return rgbToHex(r+amt*(1-r),g+amt*(1-g),b+amt*(1-b));}

// ── INDEX HELPERS (all tie-aware) ────────────────────────────────────────────
function nSmallestSet(arr,n){
  const s=arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>x.v!==null&&!isNaN(x.v)).sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v);
  if(!s.length)return new Set();
  const cut=s[Math.min(n,s.length)-1].v;
  return new Set(s.filter(x=>x.v<=cut).map(x=>x.i));
}
function nLargestSet(arr,n){
  const s=arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>x.v!==null&&!isNaN(x.v)).sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v);
  if(!s.length)return new Set();
  const cut=s[Math.min(n,s.length)-1].v;
  return new Set(s.filter(x=>x.v>=cut).map(x=>x.i));
}
function nSmallestAbsSet(arr,n){
  const s=arr.map((v,i)=>({v:Math.abs(v),i})).filter(x=>!isNaN(x.v)).sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v);
  if(!s.length)return new Set();
  const cut=s[Math.min(n,s.length)-1].v;
  return new Set(s.filter(x=>x.v<=cut).map(x=>x.i));
}
function nLargestAbsSet(arr,n){
  const s=arr.map((v,i)=>({v:Math.abs(v),i})).filter(x=>!isNaN(x.v)).sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v);
  if(!s.length)return new Set();
  const cut=s[Math.min(n,s.length)-1].v;
  return new Set(s.filter(x=>x.v>=cut).map(x=>x.i));
}
function top1Set(arr,isDelta,measure){
  const valid=arr.filter(v=>v!==null&&!isNaN(v));
  if(!valid.length)return new Set();
  if(isDelta){
    const mn=Math.min(...valid.map(Math.abs));
    return new Set(arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>Math.abs(x.v)===mn).map(x=>x.i));
  }
  if(measure==='extremity'){
    const mx=Math.max(...valid);
    return new Set(arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>x.v===mx).map(x=>x.i));
  }
  const mn=Math.min(...valid);
  return new Set(arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>x.v===mn).map(x=>x.i));
}
function top1PerCluster(arr,clustVals){
  const res=new Set();
  [...new Set(clustVals.filter(c=>c!==null))].forEach(cl=>{
    const inCl=arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>clustVals[x.i]==cl&&x.v!==null&&!isNaN(x.v));
    if(!inCl.length)return;
    const mn=Math.min(...inCl.map(x=>x.v));
    inCl.filter(x=>x.v===mn).forEach(x=>res.add(x.i));
  });
  return res;
}

// ── HIGHLIGHTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function computeHighlights(colVals,clustVals,measure,isDelta,colorMode){
  const hl=new Map();
  let closeIdx=new Set(),farIdx=new Set(),top1Idx=new Set();

  if(measure==='own'){
    [...new Set(clustVals.filter(c=>c!==null))].forEach(cl=>{
      const inCl=colVals.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>clustVals[x.i]==cl&&x.v!==null&&!isNaN(x.v)).sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v);
      if(!inCl.length)return;
      const cut=inCl[Math.min(N_TOP,inCl.length)-1].v;
      inCl.filter(x=>x.v<=cut).forEach(x=>closeIdx.add(x.i));
    });
    top1Idx=top1PerCluster(colVals,clustVals);
  }else if(measure==='extremity'){
    if(!isDelta){farIdx=nLargestSet(colVals,N_TOP);top1Idx=top1Set(colVals,false,'extremity');}
    else{closeIdx=nSmallestAbsSet(colVals,N_TOP);top1Idx=top1Set(colVals,true,'extremity');}
  }else{
    if(!isDelta){closeIdx=nSmallestSet(colVals,N_TOP);farIdx=nLargestSet(colVals,N_TOP);top1Idx=top1Set(colVals,false,'global');}
    else{closeIdx=nSmallestAbsSet(colVals,N_TOP);farIdx=nLargestAbsSet(colVals,N_TOP);top1Idx=top1Set(colVals,true,'global');}
  }

  colVals.forEach((_,ri)=>{
    const cl=clustVals?String(clustVals[ri]):null;
    let cellBg=null,bubbleBg=null;

    if(colorMode==='clusters'||colorMode==='clusters_top1'){
      if(cl&&CLUSTER_COLORS[cl]) cellBg=CLUSTER_COLORS[cl];
    }
    if(colorMode==='extremes'||colorMode==='extremes_top1'){
      if(measure==='own'){
        if(closeIdx.has(ri)&&cl&&CLUSTER_COLORS[cl]) cellBg=CLUSTER_COLORS[cl];
      }else if(measure==='extremity'){
        if(farIdx.has(ri)) cellBg=EXTREMES_FAR;
        if(closeIdx.has(ri)) cellBg=EXTREMES_CLOSE;
      }else{
        if(closeIdx.has(ri)) cellBg=EXTREMES_CLOSE;
        if(farIdx.has(ri)) cellBg=EXTREMES_FAR;
      }
    }

    const isTop1=top1Idx.has(ri)&&(colorMode==='top1'||colorMode==='clusters_top1'||colorMode==='extremes_top1');
    if(isTop1){
      if(colorMode==='clusters_top1'||colorMode==='extremes_top1'){
        bubbleBg='rgba(255,255,255,0.88)';
      }else{
        if(measure==='own') bubbleBg=(cl&&CLUSTER_COLORS[cl])?lighten(CLUSTER_COLORS[cl],0.5):'#eee';
        else if(measure==='extremity') bubbleBg=lighten(EXTREMES_FAR,0.5);
        else bubbleBg=lighten(EXTREMES_CLOSE,0.5);
      }
    }
    if(cellBg||bubbleBg) hl.set(ri,{cellBg,bubbleBg});
  });
  return hl;
}

// ── SPARKLINE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildSparkline(vals,gMin,gMax){
  const W=88,H=28,P=3,rng=gMax-gMin||1;
  const pts=vals.map((v,i)=>{
    if(v===null||isNaN(v))return null;
    const x=P+(i/Math.max(vals.length-1,1))*(W-P*2);
    const y=H-P-((v-gMin)/rng)*(H-P*2);
    return`${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`;
  }).filter(Boolean);
  if(pts.length<2)return`<svg width="${W}" height="${H}"></svg>`;
  return`<svg width="${W}" height="${H}" style="display:block;overflow:visible"><polyline points="${pts.join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="#2E86B5" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;
}

// ── SORT HELPERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function rowAvg(arr){const v=arr.filter(x=>x!==null&&!isNaN(x));return v.length?v.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/v.length:Infinity;}
function rowAvgAbs(arr){const v=arr.filter(x=>x!==null&&!isNaN(x));return v.length?v.reduce((a,b)=>a+Math.abs(b),0)/v.length:Infinity;}

// ── ANNOTATION LOOKUP ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getAnn(state,yr){
  const key=`${state}__${yr}`;
  if(curMeasure==='global')   return(RAW_DATA.ann_global   &&RAW_DATA.ann_global[key])  ||null;
  if(curMeasure==='own')      return(RAW_DATA.ann_own      &&RAW_DATA.ann_own[key])     ||null;
  if(curMeasure==='extremity')return(RAW_DATA.ann_extremity&&RAW_DATA.ann_extremity[key])||null;
  return null;
}

// ── TOOLTIP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ordinal(n){
  if(n===null||isNaN(n))return'—';
  if(!Number.isInteger(n))return n.toFixed(1);
  const s=Math.round(n),sfx=['th','st','nd','rd'],v=s%100;
  return s+(sfx[(v-20)%10]||sfx[v]||sfx[0]);
}
function sgn(v){return v>=0?'+':'';}
function getVal(slice,si,yr){const yi=slice.years.indexOf(yr);if(yi<0||si>=slice.values.length)return null;return slice.values[si][yi];}

function buildTooltip(state,year){
  const yr=parseInt(year);
  const si=RAW_DATA.global_raw.states.indexOf(state);
  if(si<0)return'';
  const cyi=RAW_DATA.clusters.years.indexOf(yr);
  const cluster=(cyi>=0&&si<RAW_DATA.clusters.values.length)?RAW_DATA.clusters.values[si][cyi]:null;
  let lines=[];

  if(curMeasure==='global'){
    const raw=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_dist_1cs,si,yr);
    const rank=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_rank_1cs,si,yr);
    const delta=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_delta_1cs,si,yr);
    if(raw!==null)   lines.push(['Distance',raw.toFixed(4)]);
    if(rank!==null)  lines.push(['Rank',`${ordinal(rank)} of ${N_STATES}`]);
    if(delta!==null) lines.push(['Δ prior year',`${sgn(delta)}${delta.toFixed(4)}`]);
  }else if(curMeasure==='own'){
    const raw=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_dist_own,si,yr);
    const rank=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_rank_own,si,yr);
    const delta=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_delta_own,si,yr);
    if(raw!==null)   lines.push(['Cluster distance',raw.toFixed(4)]);
    if(rank!==null)  lines.push(['Within-cluster rank',`${ordinal(rank)}`]);
    if(delta!==null) lines.push(['Δ prior year',`${sgn(delta)}${delta.toFixed(4)}`]);
  }else{
    const raw=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_extremity,si,yr);
    const rank=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_rank_ext,si,yr);
    const delta=getVal(RAW_DATA.all_delta_ext,si,yr);
    if(raw!==null)   lines.push(['Extremity',raw.toFixed(4)]);
    if(rank!==null)  lines.push(['Rank',`${ordinal(rank)} of ${N_STATES}`]);
    if(delta!==null) lines.push(['Δ prior year',`${sgn(delta)}${delta.toFixed(4)}`]);
  }
  if(cluster!==null) lines.push(['Cluster',String(cluster)]);

  const annNote=getAnn(state,yr);
  let html=`<div class="tt-title">${state}, ${yr}</div>`;
  html+=lines.map(([l,v])=>`<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-label">${l}</span><span>${v}</span></div>`).join('');
  if(annNote) html+=`<div class="tt-note">&#128204; ${annNote}</div>`;
  return html;
}

// ── BUILD TABLE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildTableData(){
  const key=curMeasure==='extremity'?'ext_'+curTransform:curMeasure+'_'+curTransform;
  const slice=RAW_DATA[key];
  if(!slice)return null;
  const{states,years,values:vals}=slice;
  const clustDat=RAW_DATA.clusters;
  const isDelta=curTransform.includes('delta');
  const isRanked=curTransform.includes('ranked');

  let gMin=Infinity,gMax=-Infinity;
  vals.forEach(row=>row.forEach(v=>{if(v!==null&&!isNaN(v)){if(v<gMin)gMin=v;if(v>gMax)gMax=v;}}));

  const cym={};
  clustDat.years.forEach((yr,ci)=>{cym[yr]=ci;});

  const colHL=years.map((yr,yi)=>{
    const cv=vals.map(r=>r[yi]);
    const ci=cym[yr];
    const clv=ci!==undefined?clustDat.values.map(r=>r[ci]):new Array(states.length).fill(null);
    return computeHighlights(cv,clv,curMeasure,isDelta,curColor);
  });

  const avgs=vals.map(row=>(curMeasure==='extremity'&&!isDelta)?-rowAvg(row):isDelta?rowAvgAbs(row):rowAvg(row));
  const order=avgs.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v).map(x=>x.i);

  const rows=order.map(si=>{
    const state=states[si];
    const row=[
      `<div class="cv">${state}</div>`,
      `<div class="spark-cell">${buildSparkline(vals[si],gMin,gMax)}</div>`
    ];
    years.forEach((yr,yi)=>{
      const raw=vals[si][yi];
      const h=colHL[yi].get(si);
      const annNote=getAnn(state,yr);
      const disp=(raw===null||raw===undefined||isNaN(raw))?''
        :isRanked?(Number.isInteger(raw)?String(raw):raw.toFixed(1))
        :raw.toFixed(4);
      const da=`data-state="${state}" data-year="${yr}"`;

      // Wrap the number text in a span if there's a note
      const inner=annNote?`<span class="has-note">${disp}</span>`:disp;

      if(!h){
        row.push(`<div class="cv" ${da}>${inner}</div>`);
      }else{
        const bg=h.cellBg?`background:${h.cellBg};`:'';
        const fg=h.cellBg?'color:#fff;':'';
        if(h.bubbleBg){
          // bubble wraps the inner span
          const bubbleContent=annNote?`<span class="has-note">${disp}</span>`:disp;
          row.push(`<div class="cv" style="${bg}${fg}" ${da}><span class="bubble" style="background:${h.bubbleBg};color:#222;">${bubbleContent}</span></div>`);
        }else{
          row.push(`<div class="cv" style="${bg}${fg}" ${da}>${inner}</div>`);
        }
      }
    });
    return row;
  });
  return{years,rows};
}

// ── RENDER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function render(){
  document.getElementById('sub-measure').textContent  =SUB_MEASURE[curMeasure]||'';
  document.getElementById('sub-transform').textContent=SUB_TRANSFORM[curTransform]||'';
  document.getElementById('sub-color').textContent    =(SUB_COLOR[curMeasure]||{})[curColor]||'';

  const result=buildTableData();
  if(!result){
    document.getElementById('tbl-wrapper').innerHTML='<p style="color:#c00;padding:1rem;">Not available for this combination.</p>';
    return;
  }
  const{years,rows}=result;
  const columns=[
    {title:'State',  orderable:true},
    {title:'Trend',  orderable:false}
  ].concat(years.map(y=>({title:String(y),orderable:true})));

  if(dtInstance){dtInstance.destroy();}
  document.getElementById('tbl-wrapper').innerHTML='<table id="main-dt" class="display"></table>';

  dtInstance=$('#main-dt').DataTable({
    data:rows, columns, paging:false, searching:false, info:false,
    ordering:true, order:[], scrollX:true,
    fixedColumns:{leftColumns:2},
    columnDefs:[
      {targets:0,width:'130px',className:'dt-left',  orderable:true},
      {targets:1,width:'100px',className:'dt-left',  orderable:false},
      {targets:'_all',className:'dt-center',width:'68px'}
    ],
    dom:'t',
    createdRow:function(row){$(row).find('td').css('padding','0');}
  });

  // Remove any stray empty first row DataTables sometimes injects
  $('#main-dt tbody tr:first-child').each(function(){
    if($(this).find('td').first().text().trim()===''){$(this).remove();}
  });

  attachTooltips();
}

// ── TOOLTIP EVENTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function attachTooltips(){
  const tip=document.getElementById('cell-tooltip');
  $(document).off('mouseenter mousemove mouseleave','.cv[data-state]');
  $(document).on('mouseenter','.cv[data-state]',function(e){
    const html=buildTooltip(this.dataset.state,this.dataset.year);
    if(!html)return;
    tip.innerHTML=html;tip.style.display='block';posTip(e);
  });
  $(document).on('mousemove','.cv[data-state]',function(e){posTip(e);});
  $(document).on('mouseleave','.cv[data-state]',function(){tip.style.display='none';});
}
function posTip(e){
  const tip=document.getElementById('cell-tooltip');
  const tw=tip.offsetWidth||280,th=tip.offsetHeight||120;
  let x=e.clientX+14,y=e.clientY+14;
  if(x+tw>window.innerWidth -10)x=e.clientX-tw-10;
  if(y+th>window.innerHeight-10)y=e.clientY-th-10;
  tip.style.left=x+'px';tip.style.top=y+'px';
}

// ── BUTTON HANDLERS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function setMeasure(btn){
  curMeasure=btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll('#row-measure .ctrl-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===btn));
  enforceConstraints();render();
}
function setTransform(btn){
  if(btn.classList.contains('disabled'))return;
  curTransform=btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll('#row-transform .ctrl-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===btn));
  render();
}
function setColor(btn){
  curColor=btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll('#row-color .ctrl-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===btn));
  render();
}
function enforceConstraints(){
  const rd=document.querySelector('[data-val="ranked_delta"]');
  if(curMeasure==='own'){
    rd.classList.add('disabled');
    if(curTransform==='ranked_delta'){
      curTransform='raw_delta';
      document.querySelectorAll('#row-transform .ctrl-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.val===curTransform));
    }
  }else rd.classList.remove('disabled');
}

// ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$(document).ready(function(){enforceConstraints();render();});
</script>
```
